build_fbnet_backbone: build an FBNet backbone model using FBNetBuilder with a given architecture definition and width ratio
create_irf_block: create an IRFBlock inverted residual bottleneck with configurable kernel size, expansion ratio, and SE module
unify_architecture_definition: unify an FBNet architecture definition dict into a standardized stages list format with block metadata
expand_stage_config: expand a compressed stage configuration list into individual block configurations with proper stride values
add_fbnet_blocks: add a sequence of FBNet blocks to the model using the FBNetBuilder add_blocks method with stage info
